posts.name: ketigid
posts.cooked:
1. EE box was sold out, this means demand is there.

2. Current EE box have difficulty fitting all game contents, *sleeved* cards and tokens, and more cards and tokens are coming with ST.

3. There have been several people asking about boxes already in this kickstarter, again demand is there.

4. The next "big box solution" won't be produced in the near future because GtG had mentioned the next project after ST is going to be a new game, not a SotM expansion.

5. With EE box as a kickstarter ala carte will likely attract many backers to up their pledge to get the EE box, hence we can reach more stretch rewards and faster.

Post a reply if you support this so GtG knows there is demand.
